# War Scroll Column 16 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** 1QM (Cave 1), Col. 16 | **Condition:** fragmentary

---

**16:1** [...] the priests shall blow upon the trumpets [...] for the arranging of the battle-lines of [...]

**16:2** [...] and upon the trumpets-of-assembling they shall blow a flat-blast for the directing of the battle [...]

**16:3** [...they shall begin] to bring-down the slain. And all the people shall cause-to-cease the shout-of-war, but the priests shall continue blowing

**16:4** upon the trumpets-of-the-slain to direct the battle, until the enemy is smitten and they turn

**16:5** their back. And the priests shall blow to direct the battle. And when they are smitten

**16:6** before them, the priests shall blow the trumpets-of-assembling, and all the infantry-of-the-line shall go-forth

**16:7** unto them from the midst of the fallen-of-the-front, and six divisions shall stand. And the division going-forth

**16:8** with its weapons-of-war shall station-itself at its post. And six divisions shall take-up-position,

**16:9** all-of-them together: twenty-six divisions. And the horsemen on the right and on the left

**16:10** of the battle-line shall stand: six hundred on the one-side and six hundred on the other-side.

**16:11** And when Belial girds-himself to assist the Sons-of-Darkness, and the slain-of-the-infantry begin to fall

**16:12** by-the-mysteries-of-God, to test by-them all-those-appointed for battle — the priests

**16:13** shall blow the trumpets-of-summoning for another battle-line to go-forth as a relief-force to take-the-place

**16:14** [...] and the priests shall blow for them the signals to arrange-the-ranks [...]

**16:15** [...] and with the blowing of the priests [...] to test by these mysteries [...all those appointed]

**16:16** for the battle [...] and the mighty-ones-of [...] the war [...] God-of-Israel [...]

**16:17** [...] for all the appointed-times of eternity [...]

---

*EMET notes: Column 16 is fragmentary, especially lines 1-3 and 14-17. Lacunae marked with [...]. Construct chains hyphenated throughout. "Mysteries" (razei) preserves Hebrew raz, a key Qumran theological term. "Belial" left untranslated as a proper noun. Line numbering follows Sukenik/Yadin standard edition.*
